**Male**: Again, really obvious, but this is to be used on any bot that is biologically born a man.

**Female**: Same as above, but this time, for our lovely ladies, this is to be used if the bot is biologically born as a woman.

**Trans**: This is short for transgender, a good tag to use if you're illustrating a bot going through transition from one gender to another or that they identify with that is different to their birth.

**Non-Binary**: For any characters out there that do not associate themselves to any gender, remember, we do not discriminate here.

**MalePOV**: This is point of view tag for bots with male user focus, add if bot is focused on one particular gender.

**FemalePOV**: Same as above, but this time, for the female users, add only if focused on one gender.

Proposal for a new tag: **AnyPOV**! There are users that do not identify with Male or Female genders and are seeking greetings that aren't gender-specific. Some people identify with more than one gender and prefer to use/favorite bots that are written where they can do both freely. Edited to add: I also think it should be encouraged to *not* use the NB tag for inanimate objects, RPGs/Sims, etc.

The problem is that the term itself is always used in an inflationary way and also has various nuances.

NTR can be associated with cheating without any major problems. Even if cheating is more about sexually unfulfilled desires.

But NTR is really more about stealing. In many cases, one partner leaves the other because the new one can satisfy them sexually much better.

Recently, I have also seen more and more works in the H area that utilise a subgenre. This can be roughly summarised as ‘I loved her/him first’.
A subgenre that is primarily seen in romantic works. Where the female protagonist gets another love interest who has known her longer than the male protagonist.
This is also NTR.

What you're suggesting is also a subgenre of what I just mentioned. Except that in this case, the ‘stolen person’ remains with the partner. However, it can also be combined with normal swinging.
